# Visual Sales Report for the Online Store

A clean dashboard should show **revenue trend by category**, **product mix**, and **conversion efficiency** side by side. Since the dataset is category-based, the strongest design is a **combo bar + line chart** for revenue, a **donut chart** for mix, and a **funnel or rate bar chart** for conversion.

## Recommended Chart Design

| Visualization Goal | Best Chart Type | Why It Works | What to Put on It |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue trends | **Sorted bar chart** or **combo bar + line** | Makes category revenue easy to compare and rank | X-axis: Category; Y-axis: Revenue USD; optional line: Orders |
| Product mix | **Donut chart** | Best for showing share of total revenue or orders | Slice by Category using Revenue share |
| Conversion efficiency | **Funnel chart** or **conversion-rate bar chart** | Shows how well traffic turns into orders | Visits → Add to Cart → Orders, plus order rate by category |

### Best choice by business question
- **Revenue trends:** Use a **sorted horizontal bar chart** with categories ordered by revenue.
- **Product mix:** Use a **donut chart** based on **Revenue_USD share**.
- **Conversion efficiency:** Use a **bar chart of order conversion rate** by category, with a funnel summary above it.

## Key Metrics by Category

| Category | Visits | Add to Cart | Orders | Revenue USD | Cart Rate | Order Rate | Revenue per Visit |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Electronics | 12,400 | 980 | 420 | 84,000 | 7.9% | 3.4% | $6.77 |
| Home | 9,800 | 760 | 310 | 37,200 | 7.8% | 3.2% | $3.80 |
| Beauty | 11,200 | 910 | 455 | 40,950 | 8.1% | 4.1% | $3.66 |
| Books | 7,600 | 540 | 260 | 7,800 | 7.1% | 3.4% | $1.03 |
| Sports | 6,900 | 610 | 240 | 28,800 | 8.8% | 3.5% | $4.17 |

## Top 2 Business Takeaways

- **Electronics is the revenue leader** at **$84,000**, with the highest revenue per visit, so it deserves prominent placement in merchandising and paid traffic.
- **Beauty is the most efficient conversion category** with the highest order rate at **4.1%**, while **Books underperforms sharply on revenue per visit**, suggesting pricing, bundling, or assortment issues.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Build dashboard] https://www.google.com/search?q=dashboard+design+bar+chart+donut+chart+conversion+funnel
Action: [Button: Export chart ideas] https://www.google.com/search?q=best+chart+types+for+revenue+mix+conversion+dashboard

## Sources

- Chart selection guidance: https://www.tableau.com/learn/articles/data-visualization
- Funnel and conversion analysis concepts: https://www.google.com/search?q=conversion+funnel+analysis+ecommerce+metrics
